---
title: "Installing snp.slicer"
output: html_document
---



SNP-Slice was published as a set of analysis scripts in the [original repository](https://github.com/nianqiaoju/snp-slice). Those scripts are not an R package, and getting them installed and running is difficult. [`snp.slicer`](https://github.com/plasmogenepi/snp.slicer) is the R package implementation of that algorithm. This tutorial uses `snp.slicer`.

The package is on the [plasmogenepi.r-universe](https://plasmogenepi.r-universe.dev/snp.slicer). Install it with:


::: {.cell}

```{.r .cell-code}
install.packages(
  "snp.slicer",
  repos = c(
    "https://plasmogenepi.r-universe.dev",
    "https://cloud.r-project.org"
  )
)
```
:::
